newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent unleaded firms on refiner buying.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent unleaded firms on refiner buying.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline basis firmed in Group Three on late-month refiner buying that pushed differentials higher on Friday, traders said.
Conoco, Coastal and Texaco were sighted in the market for late-November barrels, traders said.
In Chicago, traders were shifting focus to early December barrels as talk wound down in late-November deliveries ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday next week.

Group Three unleaded firmed to bids 5.0 cents a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries, up nearly two cents a gallon from the prior day's talk. Later deliveries were bid 3.50 cents over NYMEX December unleaded.
Chicago unleaded was talked 3.75/4.0 cents a gallon over the print for late-November deliveries, with first-cycle December barrels 4.50/4.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX January unleaded futures.

Group Three low sulphur diesel differentials were steady at 0.75/0.50 cent a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 1.0/0.75 cent under for later deliveries. High sulphur remained 1.50 cent a gallon under the print.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was bid 1.0 cent a gallon over NYMEX December heating oil for late-November deliveries, and high sulphur was bid even with the print.
